title: Splice Instrument Forge
idiom: hand-coloured Agricola-style woodcut, a smith forging a drum from raw discs
hero_prompt: Hand-coloured woodcut in the manner of a 16th-century mining and metalworking book, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible woodcut line and watercolour texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: a stone smithy with an open brick forge burning orange, a woman blacksmith in a leather apron seen in profile at an anvil, her hammer raised over a small round drum shell that she holds steady with long tongs; beside the fire a tall stack of flat, plain round discs of dark stock waits like raw ore, and along the back wall a wooden rack holds a neat row of finished small round drums, each one slightly different in size, ready to be taken away. Fire orange, charcoal, ochre and cream.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a fire-orange ground, no shading or gradients: a blacksmith's anvil with one small round drum standing on its flat top and three short spark lines above it. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
